chooseModeDescription: For testing, explicitly choose the existing isolated browser or a native tab shared through the extension. There is no automatic fallback.
localExplanation: Pair this agent with Chrome, Edge or Safari on Mac (18.4 minimum). You may then close this dialog: pairing remains active while this conversation is open. Keep Mergeron in the same browser and profile.
localPrivacy: Administrator-only preview. Share suitable pages only: visible text may contain private information. Reading skips known field values and exports no cookies or passkeys. Review every screenshot before confirming: masking fields and iframes cannot detect every secret. Pause sharing and authenticate yourself manually. Every agent action requires your approval here.
localDownload: Chrome / Edge: download and extract the extension
localInstallSteps: Open chrome://extensions or edge://extensions, enable developer mode, then Load unpacked from the extracted folder.
localSafariDownload: Safari on Mac: download the test package
localSafariInstall: Safari 18.4 or later: Settings → Developer → Add Temporary Extension, then select the Safari ZIP or its extracted folder. If Developer is missing, enable web developer features in Settings → Advanced. Approve the unsigned extension yourself, then open its options from its toolbar icon.
localSafariTemporary: Test installation only: Safari removes the extension when it quits or after 24 hours. Reinstall it and pair again. This package does not target iPhone/iPad.
localConfigure: In the extension options, authorize only {{origin}}, then reload this Mergeron tab.
localConnect: Pair the extension with this agent
localFailed: Connection interrupted or extension unavailable. Sharing is revoked; no action is retried. Check the installation, reload Mergeron and create a new pairing.
localPairSteps: Open the extension icon, verify the code and confirm pairing. Then choose any suitable HTTPS page and click Point: sharing of that tab resumes automatically.
localStatePairing: Waiting for confirmation in the extension
localStatePaused: Sharing paused — resume from the extension
localShared: Click Point in the extension to share the foreground tab, even after reloading it. After selecting an element, review the screenshot and add it to the message. Write or complete your text directly in the conversation, then send it yourself.
localApprovalExpired: This request expired or can no longer be approved. Ask the agent for a fresh observation; no action was retried.
localAnnotationOnly: Mergeron annotations only: agent commands are not allowed on this page.
localAnnotationInProgress: Pointing or commenting: agent commands are paused.
localAnnotationAdding: Adding the screenshot to the message input…
localAnnotationAdded: Screenshot added to the message input. Complete your message, then send it.
localAnnotationFailed: Insertion was not confirmed. Check the message input; no automatic retry will occur.
sessionExpired: The remote session expired or the service restarted. Its pages and inputs cannot be restored. This tab is retained; click Open to start a new page.
desktopSplitDefault: Open side by side on large screens
mobileFullWidth: On mobile, the browser always uses the full width.
settingsApplyNew: These settings apply to new browsers. Each browser has its own isolated session. Secondary windows stay in that session and are limited to five pages. Native passkey dialogs are not web pages and are not streamed.
settingsFailed: Could not save settings. Check the HTTP(S) address, without credentials.
controlRequired: Another view controls this browser. Choose Take control to replace it.
staleView: The page changed. Take control again before continuing; no input was retried automatically.
liveFailed: Live view was interrupted. Take control to reconnect; actions are not replayed.
livePage: Live remote page — click to interact
liveKeyboard: Keyboard input for the remote page
notConfigured: The isolated browser is not configured on this server. An administrator must enable its service before pages can be opened.
runtimeUnavailable: The isolated browser service cannot be reached. Check that it is running and its connection to Mergeron is configured.
timedOut: The browser did not respond in time. Retry or clear its session before reopening the page.
busy: The browser is busy or at capacity. Wait for the operation to finish or close another session.
tabLimit: The five-tab limit has been reached. Close a tab before creating another.
tabMissing: This tab no longer exists, for example after a server restart. Close and reopen the browser panel.
invalidUrl: Invalid address. Enter a complete http:// or https:// URL without credentials in the address.
navigationFailed: Unable to load this page: the site, certificate or network may be unavailable, or the destination may be blocked. Only public HTTP(S) sites are allowed, not private or local addresses.
operationFailed: This browser operation failed. Refresh the image or reopen the page. If it persists, check the isolated browser service.
accessDenied: Access denied. Sign in with an administrator account that can access this conversation; the browser is unavailable when testing a standard user's rights.
networkFailed: Unable to reach Mergeron. Check your connection and retry.
title: Browser
intro: Enter a URL and click Open. A tab is created if needed. Click the page to navigate, or enable pointing to annotate an element.
text: Text to enter in the focused field
added: Annotation and screenshot added to the draft. Review them, then send your message.
draftUnavailable: Could not add to this conversation’s draft. Check that it is writable.
unavailable: Browser unavailable. Check your connection, administrator access and isolated browser configuration.
privacy: Temporary remote session. Screenshots may show text entered in fields: review them before sending. Only annotations added to the draft and sent reach the agent.
frame: Embedded frame: the marker identifies the frame, not its contents
